beats.care: Preparing for MPSC? Watch for the exam calendar and the Jan 3 Group C exam; the probe could shape future exams.
beats.what: The state formed a panel led by ex-Chief Justice Dilip Bhosale. MPSC chairman Vivek Bhimanwar will stay on leave until it reports.
beats.why: Aspirants alleged paper leaks and irregularities and wanted the chairman out. The deal came after talks with Minister Shivendrasinhraje Bhosale.

cards.body: Aspirants camped at S M Joshi Bridge for days. A student leader said the stir is "suspended in principle, not withdrawn" and will restart if the report is late.
Led by ex-Bombay HC Chief Justice Dilip Bhosale, with IAS officer Tukaram Mundhe as secretary.
cards.caption: members on the inquiry panel

cards.body: Draft promises reported by FPJ include more than doubling posts in the Jan 3 Group C exam and filling 1,600 PWD posts in 15 days.

cards.q: Will the probe restore trust in MPSC?

opts: So the probe is independent of MPSC itself
cards.q: Why did students want an outside judicial panel?
cards.why: A panel led by a former judge can examine leak claims without MPSC investigating itself.

cover.label: Deadline for the MPSC probe report

hook: After days on a Pune bridge, what did *MPSC aspirants* win?

learn.t: IAS officer Tukaram Mundhe, whom students had demanded, is secretary of the five-member inquiry panel.
